description: This file is a FastAPI application module that defines a web endpoint to retrieve settings information. It imports configuration settings, sets up dependency injection via cache, and exposes an API route /info.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings class imported from the local config module, likely a Pydantic model containing application settings such as app_name, admin_email, and items_per_user.

methods.name: get_settings()
methods.description: Cached function that returns a singleton instance of the Settings configuration.

methods.name: info(settings: Annotated[config.Settings, Depends(get_settings)])
methods.description: API route handler for GET /info that returns application settings data.
